data.case_title: Income tax assessment 2025 (Einkommensteuerbescheid) – back payment due
data.summary: The Finanzamt Beispiel-Weserufer issued the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025, finding a back payment (Nachzahlung) of €1,284.00 due by 4 May 2027, because unemployment benefits received from January to March 2025 raised the tax rate (Progressionsvorbehalt).
data.explanation: This is your official tax assessment for 2025. It shows you owe €1,284.00 in additional tax, mainly because tax-free unemployment benefits you received increased your tax rate under a rule called Progressionsvorbehalt. You must transfer this amount to the tax office's account by the stated due date, quoting your tax number; paying late triggers late-payment surcharges (Säumniszuschläge). If you believe the assessment is wrong, you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the tax office; the app shows until when you can still do so. If you take no action, the assessment becomes final.
data.tax_note: This is the final tax assessment for 2025; keep it as proof of your tax liability, the unemployment benefit amount used for the Progressionsvorbehalt, and the deductions applied (Werbungskosten, Sonderausgaben).

remedy.period_text: Ihr Einspruch muss innerhalb eines Monats eingelegt werden; die Monatsfrist rechnet vom Ende des Tages an, an dem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist.
remedy.form_text: schriftlich, elektronisch über ELSTER oder durch Erklärung zur Niederschrift
remedy.quote: Der Einspruch ist beim Finanzamt Beispiel-Weserufer einzulegen, und zwar schriftlich, elektronisch über ELSTER oder durch Erklärung zur Niederschrift.

items.title: Decide whether to file an objection (Einspruch) against the assessment
items.action: If you think the assessment is incorrect, you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the tax office in writing, via ELSTER, or by declaration recorded at the office; the app shows the deadline.
items.consequence: If you miss the deadline, the assessment becomes final and can no longer be challenged.
